name: I Write Games Not Tragedies
source:
Write Games Not Tragedies is a narrative-driven rhythm game that pays homage to British emo and goth subcultures. Follow Ash’s journey of self-discovery from young goth in the early 2000s to elder emo in the 2020s, via a battle with addiction in the 2010s.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3396670/I_Write_Games_Not_Tragedies/]Steam[/url]]
